headline: Tainan presale home prices down 20% in first half; Guocheng Baoshi tops unit price list at NT$689,000 per ping - Finance
summary: Presale home prices in Tainan fell 20% in the first half, while high-priced units such as Guocheng Baoshi in East District still led transaction unit prices. Buying sentiment has cooled.
why: Housing prices and transaction volumes feed into bank mortgage books, construction activity and household wealth, so they matter to real estate and banking investors.
